title: A unitized encapsulation architecture with durable epitaxial ion-conductive scaffolds for ultrastable solid-state sulfur cathode
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4162-4175
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05668J, Paper
Minkang Wang, Han Su, Yu Zhong, Chuming Zhou, Guoli Chen, Xiuli Wang, Jiangping Tu
